info.title: StreetEye API
info.description:
Backend API for the StreetEye mobile app — street photography assignments, journal, and badges.

**Authentication:** All protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

**Localisation:** Pass `Accept-Language: ru` or `Accept-Language: en` to get localised content (default: `en`).

**Response format:** All responses are wrapped: `{ success, data, meta: { timestamp } }`.
